name: Tachibana Eletech Co., Ltd.
summary: Tachibana Eletech Co., Ltd. operates as a technology-driven trading company in Japan and internationally. It operates through Factory Automation System, Semiconductors Device Business, and Facility Business segments. The Factory Automation Systems segment sells programmable controllers, inverters, AC servos, motors, power distribution control equipment, industrial robots, electric discharge machines, laser processing machines, connectors, embedded equipment, industrial computers, and touch panel monitors.
